select: highest dev greedy top-1 macro (exact reference agreement, NFC), then lower dev mean CER, then earlier update
input: lower-cased English word as UTF-8 bytes + EOS (unchanged from E06); no pronunciation, no prefix
fixes: max_new_tokens 121 with a no_eos status (latent E06 defect)
LoRA wrapper exposes the frozen base weight so FFN layers can be adapted
metrics: top-4 oracle at equal beam-4 budget
distinct top-1 and most frequent share
rationale: reports/diagnosis.json: (1) the 1,031 words with several spellings take 46.6% of the draws (one word up to 147 draws vs a median of 19), so alternatives multiply exposure; (2) E08 was still improving at its last checkpoint with the LR decayed to 0, its final train loss (0.147) is twice E07's and it reproduces only 57% of its control rows: under-fitted at 3,000 updates. The two changes are combined for performance discovery; their separate contributions stay unresolved (no ablation).
changes_from_e08: word-level sampler: each epoch visits every English word once (seeded order) and draws one of its spellings uniformly (seeded), instead of visiting every row
peak learning rate 2e-3 instead of 1e-3 (same warm-up and linear decay)
